q.s: The permanent secretariat of BIMSTEC is located at:
q.x: BIMSTEC, with 7 members, has its secretariat in Dhaka.

q.s: Which of the following countries is NOT a member of BIMSTEC?
q.x: BIMSTEC's 7 members are Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka and Thailand.

q.s: The first G20 Leaders' Summit was held in the year:
q.x: The G20 began in 1999 as a finance ministers' forum; the first Leaders' Summit was in 2008 at Washington.

q.s: Which of the following is NOT a feature of the G20?
o: It works through Finance and Sherpa tracks
The Troika has past, present and next presidencies
It has a permanent secretariat at Geneva
q.x: The G20 has no permanent secretariat; the presidency runs it with the Troika.

q.s: Türkiye joined NATO in the year:
q.x: Türkiye (with Greece) joined in 1952; it was not a founding member of 1949.

q.s: Which of the following countries is NOT a member of NATO?
q.x: Austria is a neutral country and not in NATO.

q.s: Which of the following trade agreements was implemented by India the earliest?
q.x: The Mauritius CECPA (2021) came first, followed by the UAE, Australia, EFTA and Oman agreements.

q.s: The International Criminal Court (ICC), set up in 2002, has its seat at:
q.x: The ICC sits at The Hague and works on the principle of complementarity.

q.s: About international courts, which of the following statements is correct?
o: The ICC settles disputes between states
The ICJ issued an arrest warrant against Putin
The ICC works on the principle of complementarity
q.x: The ICC complements national courts; the ICJ settles inter-state disputes and the arrest warrant against Putin is from the ICC.

q.s: The Executive Council of India's Nuclear Command Authority is chaired by the:
q.x: The NSA chairs the Executive Council; the PM chairs the Political Council. The doctrine (2003) follows No First Use.

q.s: Which was the first ASEAN country to buy the BrahMos cruise missile from India?
q.x: The Philippines was first; Indonesia became the second.

q.s: 'Dustlik' is a joint military exercise between India and:
q.x: Dustlik is the India-Uzbekistan exercise; its 7th edition was held in Namangan in April 2026.

q.s: The bilateral trade target set by India and Uzbekistan in 2026 is:
q.x: A target of $5 billion by 2030 was set and eleven agreements signed.

q.s: India's 'Vision MAHASAGAR', which extends the SAGAR vision, was announced in:
q.x: MAHASAGAR was announced in 2025 in Mauritius; SAGAR dates from 2015.

q.s: India announced a $175 million package in 2026 for which island nation?
q.x: The Seychelles package followed talks with President Patrick Herminie under Vision MAHASAGAR.

q.s: Under the India-US trade deal of February 2026, the US reciprocal tariff on Indian goods was reduced from 25% to:
q.x: It was cut to 18% and the extra 25% duty over Russian oil was removed.

q.s: Which Article of the UN Charter recognises the right of self-defence?
q.x: Article 51 recognises self-defence; Article 2(4) prohibits the use of force.

q.s: 'Garuda' is a joint exercise between the air forces of India and:
q.x: Garuda is the India-France air exercise; Varuna is their naval exercise and Ekatha is with the Maldives Navy.

q.s: India and the Philippines elevated their ties to a Strategic Partnership in:
q.x: The Strategic Partnership was formed in August 2025.

q.s: In July 2025, PM Modi was the chief guest at the 60th Independence Day celebrations of:
q.x: Modi was the first Indian PM to be chief guest at the Maldives Independence Day (60 years).

q.s: The National Mission on Interdisciplinary Cyber-Physical Systems (NM-ICPS) is implemented by:
q.x: DST implements NM-ICPS, which set up 25 Technology Innovation Hubs.

q.s: TiHAN, India's first testbed for autonomous navigation, is located at:
q.x: TiHAN is at IIT Hyderabad.

q.s: INS Kadamba, developed under Project Seabird, is a naval base located at:
q.x: INS Kadamba at Karwar, Karnataka, was commissioned in 2005 and is under the Western Naval Command.

q.s: EOS-05 (GISAT-1A), launched in September 2026, can image the Indian subcontinent once every:
q.x: From geostationary orbit it can image the subcontinent every 30 minutes; it was launched by GSLV-F17.

q.s: KAZIND is a joint military exercise between India and:
q.x: KAZIND is the India-Kazakhstan exercise.

q.s: The Sterile Insect Technique was used by the United States to eradicate which pest by 1966?
q.x: The US eradicated the New World screwworm with the Sterile Insect Technique.

q.s: In 2024, a 14-year-old from which district became the first Indian to survive Primary Amoebic Meningoencephalitis (PAM)?
q.x: A boy from Kozhikode survived PAM in 2024; Kerala's first PAM case was in Alappuzha in 2016.

q.s: The Great Indian Bustard, the State bird of Rajasthan, is listed by the IUCN as:
q.x: It is Critically Endangered; captive-bred birds have been released in the Desert National Park, Jaisalmer.

q.s: The Siang is the name of which river in Arunachal Pradesh?
q.x: The Yarlung Tsangpo of Tibet enters India as the Siang and becomes the Brahmaputra.

q.s: Which city was ranked the cleanest city overall in Swachh Survekshan 2025-26?
q.x: Navi Mumbai ranked first; Vijayawada was 3rd and Indore is now a Mentor City.

q.s: The 'National Report on Deep-Sea and Distant-Water Fishery Resources of the Indian EEZ' was released by CMLRE, located at:
q.x: CMLRE, Kochi, under the Ministry of Earth Sciences, released the report covering about 2.37 million sq km of the EEZ.

q.s: In UNICEF's Children's Climate Risk Report 2026, India scored 10 out of 10 for exposure to:
q.x: India's 10/10 was for extreme heat; its air-pollution score was 9.94.

q.s: The Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) is conducted and released by:
q.x: PLFS is an NSO, MoSPI survey; PLFS 2025 is the first with monthly rural and urban coverage.

q.s: The Global Environment Outlook (GEO-7) report is published by:
q.x: GEO is UNEP's flagship report; GEO-7 projects 1.5°C by the early 2030s and 2°C by the 2040s.

q.s: The 'Global Risks Report' is published annually by:
q.x: WEF publishes the Global Risks Report; 'Women, Business and the Law' is a World Bank report.

q.s: The report 'World Employment and Social Outlook: Trends' is published by:
q.x: The ILO brings out the employment and social trends report.

q.s: Cyclone Asna of August 2024, which formed in the Arabian Sea, finally moved towards:
q.x: Asna, a rare August cyclone in the Arabian Sea, moved towards Oman; Remal hit the Bay of Bengal coast in May 2024.

q.s: The Air Quality Life Index (AQLI) is published by:
o: Energy Policy Institute at the University of Chicago
q.x: AQLI is from EPIC, Chicago; AQLI 2025 found Bangladesh the most polluted country.

q.s: Savita Punia, conferred the Padma Shri in 2026, is associated with which sport?
q.x: Savita Punia, hockey goalkeeper from Haryana, received the Padma Shri.

q.s: Nandini Sidda Reddy received the Sahitya Akademi Award 2025 in Telugu for his poetry work:
q.x: 'Animesha' won the 2025 Telugu award; Madhurantakam Narendra won in 2022 for 'Manodharmaparagam'.

q.s: Major Malla Rama Gopal Naidu, the first person from AP and Telangana to receive the Kirti Chakra, hails from:
q.x: He is from Srikakulam and killed five terrorists on the LoC in Kupwara.

q.s: APSRTC received the Governance Now 10th PSU IT Award for its:
q.x: APSRTC won for its Automatic Announcement System.

q.s: India's highest peacetime gallantry award is the:
q.x: The Ashoka Chakra is the highest peacetime award and civilians are eligible; the Param Vir Chakra is the highest wartime award.

q.s: Which of the following is NOT a peacetime gallantry award?
q.x: The Vir Chakra is a wartime gallantry award.

q.s: Dhinidhi Desinghu won bronze medals at the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympics in which sport?
q.x: Dhinidhi won 100 m and 200 m freestyle bronzes in swimming.

q.s: Divya Deshmukh, an Arjuna Award 2025 recipient, is associated with:
q.x: Divya Deshmukh is a chess player; Lalremsiami plays hockey.

q.s: Which of the following Arjuna Award 2025 recipients is NOT correctly matched with the sport?
q.x: Ekta Bhyan is a para athlete.

q.s: The headquarters of the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) is located at:
q.x: The FAO and the World Food Programme are both in Rome.

q.s: World Food Day, observed on 16 October, was first observed in the year:
q.x: It was first observed in 1981 after the 1979 FAO Conference decision.

q.s: India's first weather derivative contract, 'RAINMUMBAI', was launched on which exchange?
q.x: RAINMUMBAI was launched on NCDEX; India's first SME semiconductor plant is at Bhiwadi, not Dholera.

q.s: Saleshwaram Jatara, called the 'Telangana Amarnath', is held inside which tiger reserve?
q.x: It is held in the Amrabad Tiger Reserve in the Nallamala of Nagarkurnool district.

q.s: Sarhul, a tribal festival of Jharkhand, involves the worship of:
q.x: Sarhul celebrates the Sal tree at the start of the new year.

q.s: The Hoysala temples inscribed by UNESCO in 2023 as 'Sacred Ensembles of the Hoysalas' do NOT include the temple at:
q.x: The site covers Belur, Halebidu and Somanathapura; Hampi is a Vijayanagara site.

q.s: Which Section of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) requires that an arrested person be informed of the grounds of arrest and the right to bail?
q.x: Section 47 BNSS; the Supreme Court has held written grounds must be supplied in a language the accused understands.

q.s: The Industrial Relations Code, 2020 merged the Industrial Disputes Act 1947, the Trade Unions Act 1926 and the:
q.x: The IR Code merged these three labour laws; the 'Triple Test' of 'industry' came from Bangalore Water Supply (1978).

q.s: India's National Anthem 'Jana Gana Mana' was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on:
q.x: It was adopted on 24 January 1950; its full version takes 52 seconds.

q.s: About the MHA guidelines on the National Song and Anthem, which of the following statements is correct?
o: The official Vande Mataram has only two stanzas
The State Song is played first
The full Jana Gana Mana takes 20 seconds
Vande Mataram is played before Jana Gana Mana in official programmes with a State song
q.x: The order is Vande Mataram, Jana Gana Mana, then the State Song; the full anthem takes 52 seconds.

q.s: Trial in absentia of a proclaimed offender is provided under which Section of the BNSS?
q.x: Section 356 BNSS allows trial in absentia of proclaimed offenders for offences punishable with 10 years or more, life or death.

q.s: In which case did the Supreme Court hold that the Speaker's decision under the Tenth Schedule is subject to judicial review?
q.x: Kihoto Hollohan (1992) upheld the anti-defection law but made the Speaker's decision justiciable.

q.s: Under the proposal to expand the Lok Sabha to about 816 seats, the share of each State in the total seats would:
q.x: Each State's proportion stays the same; southern seats would rise from 129 to 195.

q.s: The Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Amendment Act, 2019 raised the strength of the Supreme Court, including the CJI, to:
q.x: The 2019 Act raised it to 34; the 2008 Act had made it 31.

q.s: When the Constitution came into force in 1950, the Supreme Court had how many judges including the CJI?
q.x: It started with 8 judges; the 1956 Act raised it to 11.

q.s: A resolution for the removal of the Speaker of the Lok Sabha must be passed by:
o: A majority of all the then members of the House
Two-thirds of members present and voting
A simple majority of members present
q.x: Article 94(c) requires a majority of all the then members, after 14 days' notice.

q.s: Under the SHANTI Act, 2025 on nuclear energy, appeals lie with the:
q.x: Appeals go to APTEL; the Act caps nuclear liability at 300 million SDR.

q.s: The Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1976 gives effect to which Article of the Constitution?
q.x: Article 23 prohibits forced labour; Article 17 abolishes untouchability.

q.s: 'Sagarmanthan - The Great Oceans Dialogue' is organised by the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways with:
q.x: Sagarmanthan is held with ORF; the Kautilya Economic Conclave is organised by the Finance Ministry with IEG.

q.s: CSIR-Central Electrochemical Research Institute (CECRI) is located at:
q.x: CSIR-CECRI is at Karaikudi in Tamil Nadu.

q.s: In its August 2026 policy, the RBI's Monetary Policy Committee kept the repo rate at:
q.x: The repo rate was held at 5.25%; the CPI forecast for 2026-27 was revised to 5.0%.

q.s: PM MITRA parks are meant for the development of which sector?
q.x: Seven PM MITRA textile parks (₹4,445 crore) follow the 5F vision ending with 'Foreign'.

q.s: Domestic urea production in India depends heavily on imported:
q.x: Urea plants use natural gas (mostly imported LNG) as feedstock, so LNG supply disruptions cut output.

q.s: In the new GDP series released in 2026, the base year was revised from 2011-12 to:
q.x: The new base year is 2022-23, using GST and vehicle registration data.

q.s: In April 2026, which State recorded the highest CPI inflation in India?
q.x: Telangana (5.81%) was highest, ahead of AP (4.20%), against a national rate of 3.48%.

q.s: Kerosene supplied through the Public Distribution System is dyed:
q.x: PDS kerosene is dyed blue to prevent its use in adulterating diesel.

q.s: 'Thalinomics', the economics of a plate of food in India, was introduced in the Economic Survey of:
q.x: Thalinomics was in the 2019-20 Survey; Universal Basic Income was discussed in 2016-17.

q.s: The 'Chakravyuha Challenge' (easy entry but difficult exit for firms) appeared in the Economic Survey of:
q.x: It was in Arvind Subramanian's 2015-16 Survey; the Bare Necessities Index was in 2020-21.

q.s: The PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana is modelled on:
q.x: It is modelled on the Aspirational Districts Programme (2018) and converges 36 schemes of 11 Ministries.

q.s: The Health Survey and Development Committee of 1946, which laid the foundation of public health care in India, was headed by:
q.x: The Bhore Committee defined universal health care as care for all irrespective of ability to pay.

q.s: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY provides health cover of up to what amount per family per year?
q.x: PM-JAY gives ₹5 lakh per family a year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation.

q.s: The 'Adi Karmayogi Abhiyan' aims to train about 20 lakh grassroots workers for:
q.x: It is a tribal-affairs capacity-building mission for grassroots workers in tribal areas.

q.s: The foodgrain production target for 2026-27, announced in September 2026, was:
q.x: The target is 373.93 million tonnes, below the record 376.56 million tonnes of 2025-26.

q.s: The Law Commission of India is a:
o: Non-statutory body set up by executive order
q.x: It is set up by executive order; the 23rd Law Commission (2024-27) is chaired by Justice Dinesh Maheshwari.

q.s: About national bodies, which of the following statements is correct?
o: The National Commission for Women is a statutory body
The Law Commission is created under Article 323
The NCW is a constitutional body
The Law Commission is a statutory body
q.x: The NCW is statutory (NCW Act, 1990); the Law Commission is set up by executive order.

q.s: Which ILO Convention deals with decent work for domestic workers?
q.x: C189 (2011) covers domestic workers; India voted for it but has not ratified it.

q.s: The white-bellied heron, threatened by a proposed hydropower project, is found in which river basin of Arunachal Pradesh?
q.x: The Lohit basin holds about 70% of India's white-bellied herons, an IUCN Critically Endangered bird.

q.s: The snake eel 'Bascanichthys chepakakiensis', a new species, was discovered near:
q.x: It was found near Kakinada Fishing Harbour in Andhra Pradesh.

q.s: Glaw Lake, designated India's 101st Ramsar site in August 2026, is the first Ramsar site of:
q.x: Glaw Lake is Arunachal Pradesh's first Ramsar site; Surha Tal (Ballia) became the 100th.

q.s: Bawan Buti sarees, which received a GI tag in 2026, belong to which district of Bihar?
q.x: Bawan Buti sarees are from Nalanda; Patharkatti stone craft is from Gaya.

q.s: The Western Ghats are counted among the world's:
q.x: They are one of the 8 hottest hotspots, with about 7,400 plant species, about 30% endemic.

q.s: NTR district of Andhra Pradesh was carved out of which district in 2022?
q.x: NTR district (headquarters Vijayawada) was carved out of Krishna district.

q.s: The Swarna Andhra @2047 Vision targets an Andhra Pradesh economy of what size by 2047?
q.x: It targets USD 2.4 trillion and a per capita income of about USD 42,000.

q.s: The Rubber Board of India is headquartered at:
q.x: The Rubber Board is at Kottayam, Kerala.

q.s: As per the 2025-26 advance estimates, which district of Andhra Pradesh ranks first in Gross District Domestic Product (GDDP)?
q.x: Visakhapatnam is first in GDDP and per capita income; Parvathipuram Manyam is last in per capita income.

q.s: Andhra Pradesh's outstanding debt in 2026-27 is estimated at about what share of GSDP?
q.x: Debt is about 36% of GSDP (about ₹7.11 lakh crore).

q.s: As per AP crime review data for 2025, overall crime in Andhra Pradesh compared with 2024:
q.x: Overall crime fell 5.5%, while economic offences rose 6.6%; Annamayya saw the highest rise.

q.s: The Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026-27 was presented by Finance Minister:
q.x: Payyavula Keshav presented it on 14 February 2026 with an outlay of about ₹3.32 lakh crore.

q.s: Ramayapatnam port, a state port of Andhra Pradesh, is located in which district?
q.x: Ramayapatnam is in Prakasam; Mulapeta is in Srikakulam and Machilipatnam in Krishna.

q.s: Which of the following ports of Andhra Pradesh is NOT correctly matched with its district?
q.x: Kakinada Gateway Port is in the Kakinada SEZ.

q.s: The design of Bhogapuram International Airport is inspired by:
q.x: Its design draws on Chuttilu cottages and Araku Valley; it has a 3,800 m runway.

q.s: The AI-Quantum Centre of Excellence to be set up with the UN International Computing Centre (UNICC) will come up at:
q.x: It is planned in Amaravati Quantum Valley; AP signed the MoU at the India AI Impact Summit.

q.s: The Polavaram project was declared a national project under which Section of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014?
q.x: Section 90 declares Polavaram a national project; the Centre funds it and the State builds it.

q.s: The advisory committee for the Green Hydrogen Valley-Amaravati is chaired by:
q.x: NITI Aayog Member Dr. V.K. Saraswat chairs it; the Chief Secretary is Co-Chairman.

q.s: The Adani pumped storage project in Andhra Pradesh is located in which district?
q.x: The Adani PSP is in Kadapa; the 1,200 MW pumped hydro storage of January 2026 is in Kurnool.

q.s: SSAAT of Andhra Pradesh, the first State Social Audit organisation to win the SKOCH Gold Award, stands for:
o: Social Sector Audit and Assessment Team
Society for Statutory Audit and Taxation
Society for Social Audit, Accountability and Transparency
State Society for Audit and Accounts Transparency
q.x: SSAAT is the Society for Social Audit, Accountability and Transparency.

q.s: The SKOCH Group, which gives the SKOCH Awards, was founded by:
q.x: Sameer Kochhar founded the SKOCH Group in 1997.

q.s: The Gajapati-era inscription found at Tekkali in Srikakulam district is written in:
q.x: It is in Odia script and language and is dated by palaeography to the 15th century.

q.s: The State animal of residual Andhra Pradesh, notified in 2018, is the:
q.x: GO No. 59 of 2018 made the Blackbuck the State animal and the Rose-ringed Parakeet the State bird.

q.s: Which of the following is NOT a State symbol of residual Andhra Pradesh (2018)?
q.x: The peacock is the national bird; AP's State bird is the Rose-ringed Parakeet, State animal the Blackbuck and State tree the Neem.

q.s: Justice Lisa Gill, the first woman Chief Justice of the AP High Court after 2019, came on transfer from:
q.x: She came from the Punjab and Haryana High Court.

q.s: The Sri Varasiddhi Vinayaka Temple at Kanipakam is located in which district?
q.x: Kanipakam is in Chittoor district.

q.s: The Vande Mataram Coastal Cyclothon 2026 was organised by:
q.x: The CISF organised it to mark 150 years of Vande Mataram, with the theme 'Safe Coasts – Prosperous India'.

q.s: Andhra Pradesh's 'Super GST – Super Savings' campaign was led by:
q.x: The campaign was led by the Chief Minister.

q.s: Andhra Pradesh's new tourism policy is built on which model?
q.x: It uses a PPP model; AP Tourism signed 103 MoUs in 15 months.

q.s: The convenor of Andhra Pradesh's Group of Ministers on social media (October 2025) is the:
o: Commissioner/Director of Information and Public Relations
q.x: The I&PR Commissioner is convenor; Home Minister Vangalapudi Anitha is a member.
